findings.evidence: "### 13. Em Dash Overuse" heads a run of widely known mechanical tells (em dashes, boldface, title case, emojis, curly quotes, filler phrases)
findings.fix: Compress the mechanical-cue entries to a one-line checklist and keep full before/after blocks only for entries that encode judgment (sycophancy, knowledge-cutoff residue, generic positive conclusions).

findings.evidence: "Diagnose the most consequential prose issue, make targeted changes, then compare the revision with the brief and original."
findings.fix: Add the priority order: evidence risks first (vague attribution, unsupported claims), then inflation, then structure, then mechanics.

findings.evidence: "Never humanize code, API identifiers, schema keys, or other exact-match text; stylistic changes can break behavior."
findings.fix: Name the concrete failure: exact-match consumers (grep, tests, API contracts, search) match the literal string, so even case or quote-style changes break them.

findings.evidence: "requested edit depth from the request and source; ask only for missing information that changes the edit"
findings.fix: Add the unspecified-depth default: "When depth is unspecified, default to the minimal consequential edit and state that scope in the change note."
